signals.title: Tether en Kazachse centrale bank verkennen tenge-stablecoin en activatokenisering
signals.summary: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

signals.title: Tether werkt samen met Kazachstans centrale bank aan stablecoin en tokenisering
signals.summary: Tether tapped by Kazakhstan’s central bank to explore stablecoin and tokenization

signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Bitcoin.de-handel blijft stilgelegd na afwijzing MiCA-aanvraag Duitse toezichthouder
signals.summary: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: Polygon gebruikt TRON's stablecoin-liquiditeit voor grensoverschrijdende transacties
signals.summary: Polygon taps TRON’s $94 billion stablecoin supply for seamless cross-border transfers

signals.title: Olie- en gaswinsten compenseren chemiebusiness verlies bij Ineos
signals.summary: Division of Jim Ratcliffe’s conglomerate posts loss of €2.2bn last year
